title: Defect in the W5' fix: the plate press-swallow deadens the tray chips that overlap the rail — 'mid' 88/96px and 'high' 96/96px unclickable at 1280x720 (fully dead at x1.25/x1.50) while they paint OVER the plate
evidence: main.odin:1201 `if app.overlay_on && rnd.noc_panel_hit(rnd.noc_panel_rect(app.view.win_w, app.view.win_h), pos) { return true }` (its own comment claims 'the clickable surfaces — QoS, tray, chip, popover — are all inside the playfield'); tray.odin:46-49 `total_w := f32(i32(n)*cw + (i32(n)-1)*gap) / x0 := (f32(v.win_w) - total_w) / 2 / return {x0 + f32(i) * f32(cw + gap), f32(v.win_h) - f32(ch) - f32(hud(v, 10)), f32(cw), f32(ch)}` (win_w-anchored, never re-anchored to play_w); mouse.odin:304-305 `if ui { // swallowed — no tray, no drag (the base gate) }`; noc_overlay.odin:336 `NOC_RAIL_W :: NOC_PANEL_W + NOC_PLATE_PAD + NOC_PANEL_MARGIN // 524`. Geometry verified from data/pipe_tiers.json (3 tiers) + data/node_types.json (3 junction routers): n=6 chips, x0=(1280-616)/2=332 at x1.00 -> chip4 'mid' [748,844] vs plate x>=756 (88/96px dead), chip5 'high' [852,948] (100% dead); at x1.25 'mid' [775,895] and 'high' [905,1025] both 100% dead, 'basic' 9px dead; at x1.50 both fully dead, 'basic' 34px dead.
detail: The bottom band stays win_w-anchored and draws after the rail (draw_hud at main.odin:757, draw_tray at :1567), so the router_mid/router_high placement chips are VISIBLE over the plate but the new swallow runs before the tray hit-test and ui=true skips the tray loop — the clicks are dead. With D on, a player cannot arm mid/high router placement from the tray.
recommended_fix: Hit-test the tray chips BEFORE the plate swallow in effect_ui_press (or exclude the tray band from the swallow rect), or re-anchor the tray to play_w while the rail is on.

title: Plate press-swallow is gated on overlay_on alone but the plate only draws when stats_valid — clicks over the rail region are swallowed with nothing drawn for up to one tick after the first D press of a run
evidence: draw gate (main.odin:717-721): `if app.overlay_on { if app.stats_valid { rnd.draw_noc_overlay(&app.view, &app.noc_feed, &app.stats, ...) } }`; swallow gate (main.odin:1201): `if app.overlay_on && rnd.noc_panel_hit(rnd.noc_panel_rect(app.view.win_w, app.view.win_h), pos) { return true }`; stats_valid lifecycle: `app.stats_valid = false` (main.odin:877, run reset) and `app.stats_valid = true` only inside the stepped-tick branch gated `if app.stats_live || app.overlay_on` (main.odin:533,545).
detail: After a fresh run/reset, stats_valid is false until the next stepped tick (<=50ms at 20Hz) following the first D press; during that window the playfield is already shrunk and clicks at x>=756 are swallowed over an undrawn plate — an invisible dead zone the fix comment ('The plate is the top-most surface while the overlay is on') does not hold.
recommended_fix: Gate the swallow (and the wheel policy's Noc_Scroll branch) on app.stats_valid as well, matching the draw predicate, or emit stats at run start so the first D press never opens onto an undrawn plate.
